description: Outlook, German: every message ends with a signature AND a two-language legal disclaimer before the history; the disclaimer repeats at every level

text.visibleLastLine: This e-mail may contain confidential information. If you are not the intended recipient, please notify the sender and delete this message.

html.visibleLastText: This e-mail may contain confidential information. If you are not the intended recipient, please notify the sender and delete this message.

notes: The visible part ends with the disclaimer (it belongs to the new message); a disclaimer is not a history marker.
